import httpx, asyncio

def extract(s, h, url='https://example.com/sub/page'):
 s.extract_cookies(httpx.Response(200, request=httpx.Request('GET', url), headers={'set-cookie':h}))
def header(s,url): return httpx.Request('GET',url,cookies=s).headers.get('cookie')
s=httpx.CookieStore(max_cookies=3,max_cookies_per_domain=2)
extract(s,'a=1; Expires=Wed, 09 Jun 2038 10:18:14 GMT; Path=/, b=2; Path=/sub')
assert header(s,'https://example.com/sub/x')=='b=2; a=1'
assert header(s,'https://sub.example.com/sub/x') is None
extract(s,'c=3; Domain=example.com; Secure; Path=/')
assert header(s,'https://sub.example.com/')=='c=3'
assert header(s,'http://sub.example.com/') is None
assert 'a' not in s
extract(s,'b=; Max-Age=0; Path=/sub')
assert s.get('b') is None
extract(s,'__Host-bad=1; Secure; Domain=example.com; Path=/')
assert s.get('__Host-bad') is None
extract(s,'__Host-good=1; Secure; Path=/')
assert s.get('__Host-good')=='1'
s=httpx.CookieStore(); s.set('x','1',path='/'); s.set('x','2',path='/sub')
try: s['x']; raise AssertionError('missing conflict')
except httpx.CookieConflict: pass
assert s.get('x',path='/')=='1'
seen=[]
def handler(request):
 seen.append(request.headers.get('cookie')); return httpx.Response(200, headers={'set-cookie':'token=ok; Path=/'})
with httpx.Client(cookies=httpx.CookieStore(), transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)) as client:
 client.get('https://example.com/'); client.get('https://example.com/'); client.get('https://sub.example.com/')
assert seen==[None,'token=ok',None], seen
async def run():
 seen.clear()
 async with httpx.AsyncClient(cookies=httpx.CookieStore(),transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler)) as client:
  await client.get('https://example.com/'); await client.get('https://example.com/')
 assert seen==[None,'token=ok'], seen
asyncio.run(run())
print('CookieStore edge cases passed')
